title: 第5章 一巴掌打成急救第6章 怪疾天生寒体
content_zh:
“张扬，你放开我。”
“我警告你，打人是犯法的。”
叶之洋用力挣扎，可张扬的手像钳子一样，他根本逃不掉。
张扬推开办公室的门，将叶之洋扔了进去。
“柳主任，张扬动手打人，你快叫保安。”
叶之洋赶紧站起来，气急败坏地投诉。
“什么情况？”
柳飘絮看向张扬。
“我在收拾东西，他走过来，二话不说，骂我废物。”
张扬说得很平淡，因为他知道，柳飘絮肯定会比自己更生气。
果然，柳飘絮脸色刷地变了，上前狠狠抽了叶之洋一巴掌。
“让你别惹张扬，你把我的话当耳边风了？”
叶之洋骂张扬废物，就等于骂她柳飘絮眼光不行。
“他都已经离职了，你为什么还要护着他？”
叶之洋又是气愤又是不甘，眼神中还带着一抹仇恨。
张扬正好看到他这抹恶毒的眼神，单手卡住他的脖子，平举在半空。
叶之洋大脑缺氧，眼突舌伸，感觉太奶奶正在向自己招手。
“张扬，别冲动。”
柳飘絮怕他一不小心把叶之洋弄死，赶紧过来拉住他的手。
“他看你的眼神有些恶毒，我先给他点教训。”

张扬在叶之洋脸上狠狠抽了十几耳光，直到将他打成猪头，这才扔到地上。
叶之洋大口喘气，看向张扬的目光像见鬼一般。
这家伙身材比自己强不了多少，竟然能单手将自己举起来，太可怕了。
“好好配合絮姐工作，你敢背刺她，我一定废了你。”
叶之洋大脑宕机。
絮姐？
他们之间难道是……亲戚关系？
怎么可能？
叶之洋难以置信，但是现在两人关系实在太亲密，由不得他不相信。
“张扬离职，是因为他不想留在医院，不是因为你比他有本事。”
“我跟他的事情，一个字都不许说出去，否则滚蛋。”
“听到没有？”
柳飘絮劈头盖脸，就是一顿喝斥。
content_en:
"Zhang Yang, let me go."
"I'm warning you, it's illegal to hit someone."
Ye Zhiyang struggled hard, but Zhang Yang's hands were like pliers, and he couldn't escape at all.
Zhang Yang pushed open the office door and threw Ye Zhiyang in.
"Director Liu, Zhang Yang is hitting someone, please call security."
Ye Zhiyang stood up quickly and complained angrily.
"What's going on?"
Liu Piaoxu looked at Zhang Yang.
"I was packing my things, and he came over and without saying a word, he called me a waste."
Zhang Yang spoke calmly, because he knew that Liu Piaoxu would definitely be angrier than himself.
Sure enough, Liu Piaoxu's face changed drastically, and she stepped forward and slapped Ye Zhiyang hard.
"I told you not to offend Zhang Yang, but you turned a deaf ear to what I said?"
Ye Zhiyang's scolding Zhang Yang for being useless is equivalent to scolding Liu Piaoxu for her poor vision.
"He has already resigned, why are you still protecting him?"
Ye Zhiyang was angry and unwilling, with a hint of hatred in his eyes.
Zhang Yang happened to see the vicious look in his eyes, clamped his neck with one hand, and held him flat in the air.
Ye Zhiyang's brain was deprived of oxygen, his eyes were bulging, his tongue was sticking out, and he felt that his great-grandmother was waving to him.
"Zhang Yang, don't be impulsive."
Liu Piaoxu was afraid that he would accidentally kill Ye Zhiyang, so she quickly came over and held his hand.
"He looks at you a bit viciously. Let me teach him a lesson first."
Zhang Yang slapped Ye Zhiyang on the face more than ten times until he was beaten into a pig's head and then threw him to the ground.
Ye Zhiyang gasped for air and looked at Zhang Yang as if he had seen a ghost.
This guy is not much stronger than me, but he can actually lift himself up with one hand. It's terrifying.
"Cooperate well with Sister Xu. If you dare to stab her in the back, I will destroy you."
Ye Zhiyang's brain shut down.
Sister Xu?
Are they... related?
How is it possible?
Ye Zhiyang couldn't believe it, but the relationship between the two was so close now that he couldn't help but not believe it.
"Zhang Yang resigned because he didn't want to stay in the hospital, not because you were more capable than him."
"Don't say a word about what happened between me and him, or get out."
"Did you hear that?"
Liu Piaoxu scolded her head and face.
